title: Compactification comparison intertwines Frobenius
statement: Under the hypotheses of `lem-sf-native-weil-open-proper-forgetting`, for every derived native object `K`, the canonical compactification comparison intertwines the independently assembled ordinary compact-support Frobenius action and the native compact-support Frobenius action.

proof.text: Apply nativeWeil_comparison_structure to f, c and K. Its native comparison, independently derived ordinary exchange, ordinary compact-support functor and localized structure are definitionally the constructions used here. Expand the hom of the composite ordinary Frobenius isomorphism and the image isomorphism. The resulting equality is exactly the existing theorem, without any new hypothesis or choice.

lean.statement:
theorem compactificationComparison_frobenius
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [f.IsOver (Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))]
    [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    [IsSeparated (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))]
    [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))]
    [IsSeparated (Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))]
    [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))] (c : Compactification f) :
    ∀ K : DerivedCategory (ProEtaleWeilSheaf k₀ l X),
      (WeilSheaf.frobeniusPullback k₀ l Y).mapDerivedCategory.map
          ((compactificationComparison (k₀ := k₀) (l := l) f c).hom.app K) ≫
        (ordinaryCompactSupportFrobenius (k₀ := k₀) (l := l) f c K).hom =
      (nativeCompactSupportFrobenius (k₀ := k₀) (l := l) f c K).hom ≫
        (compactificationComparison (k₀ := k₀) (l := l) f c).hom.app K
